Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 5, 2026

This policy explains how Fifteen Puzzle, created by Mr. Oleski, handles information in the app and on this website.

Information collected by the app

Fifteen Puzzle works offline and does not require an account. The app does not collect or send personal information to the developer. It contains no advertising, analytics services, or tracking SDKs. These practices also apply to children using the app.

Information stored on your device

The app saves the following locally so you can continue playing and keep your preferences:

  • Your current puzzle, moves, elapsed time, and remaining hints.
  • Your completed-game statistics and personal records.
  • Your language, tile theme, haptics, and motion settings.

This information is used only for the game. The developer does not receive it, sell it, or share it with third parties. You can reset statistics and settings in the app. To remove locally stored app data on iPhone, delete the app rather than offloading it. Device backups are managed separately through your device settings.

Apple and external links

App Store downloads and Apple’s platform services are governed by Apple’s Privacy Policy. Links to external websites are subject to those websites’ privacy practices.

This website

This website does not use analytics, advertising cookies, or persistent browser storage. The playable preview keeps its progress in memory and resets when you reload the page. If the website is hosted online, the hosting provider may process technical request data, such as your IP address, to deliver the pages.

Contact

For privacy questions, email mr.oleski.info@gmail.com. If you contact us, we use your email address and message to respond to your request. Please do not include sensitive personal information.

Changes to this policy

If these practices change, this page will be updated with a new revision date.
